description: Verso: Accounts of the bookseller. People mentioned: Menaḥem, Majd b. אלעזריזי(??), a scribe and judge (al-sofer al-dayyan), Sason,  Ibn al-מדור, Hilāl the blind (al-ḍarīr), Bū ʿAlī, and the wife of Ibn Sutayt. Books mentioned include 1001 Nights (alf layla wa-layla). See also the description for the whole notebook Bodl. MS heb. f 22/19–52 (PGPID 33686).
